title: Interior Design
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units

program.section_heading: Interior Design - Certificate of Achievement: Mesa
outcomes: Communicate with other professional members of the built environment demonstrating their specialized knowledge of interior construction, building codes, equipment, materials and furnishings, and sustainable and universal design principles.

Apply critical and design thinking to identify and creatively solve problems relating to the function, aesthetics and quality of the interior environment enhancing the health, safety and welfare of the public.
Perform services relative to interior spaces, including gathering information, programming, space planning, and the creation of drawings and specifications using current technology and practices.
Demonstrate knowledge of professional and ethical practices in the field of Interior Design as well as exhibit awareness and an appreciation of cultural diversity regionally, nationally and globally.
Demonstrate the ability to work independently and collaboratively within the design community.
